---

**Date:** 2026-04-15

**Status:** Released.

**Summary:** Full rewrite of the composed Process under fire. Six pillars replace the v0.3 file set (`project-structure`, `stances`, `modes`, `operating-rules`, `tracker`, `memory`). Memory grows a five-component model (status, journal, blueprint, action tree, knowledge tree) governed by a unified tree-discipline pillar. Stances collapse to a four-dial system across two domains, with two protected infrastructure stances (Auditor, Migrator) plus three example profiles (Strategist, Editor, Architect) plugins compose against. Bootstrap becomes a two-part procedure with a shell-driven Part 1 (`setup-project.sh` + `build-process.sh`) and a Migrator-driven Part 2. Plugins are pinned by core; overlay rule allows plugin files to win at any non-protected path.

---

## Changes

### Six pillars

The composed Process loads in a fixed order: project-structure → stances → modes → operating-rules → tracker → memory. Each pillar is universal-load. Memory declares its own mandatory spine (`journal.md`, `tree-discipline.md`, `blueprint.md`).

### Four modes

Reflecting / Planning / Executing / Salvaging. Salvaging is the new mode for sustained distrust during memory reshape; the Human Lead calls entry and exit.

### Stances and dials

Stances are four-dial configurations across Chat and Work domains. Two protected infrastructure stances (Auditor, Migrator) ship in core and cannot be overridden. Three example profiles (Strategist, Editor, Architect) live in `base-stances/` as source material plugins compose into their own `stances/` folder.

### Unique-name Lore directory

The Lore folder is renamed from `.ai-lore/` to `.ai-lore-<project_name>/`. `project_name` becomes the last segment of the Lore directory and is load-bearing — every path in the Process references it through the `{lore_dir}` placeholder. The rename fixes the nested-project path-resolution failure where Claude's ancestor-walking heuristics could resolve `.ai-lore/` to an enclosing project's folder; unique names remove the ambiguity because a search for `.ai-lore-foo/` from any depth returns exactly one result. `setup-project.sh` validates the name against `^[a-zA-Z0-9_][a-zA-Z0-9_-]*$` and refuses to run if an ancestor already contains a `.ai-lore-<name>/` with the same name.

### Source and dist

Upstream is formalized as **source** (pristine, pinned, never hand-edited) and Process is formalized as **dist** (built, substituted, disposable). Substitution flows one way — source → dist. This clarifies what is actually happening in the build and makes integrity verification possible (byte-compare Upstream against the git pin).

### Versioned Upstream, single-version Process, staged builds in `dist/`

Upstream is versioned: `upstream/core-<version>/` holds one folder per pinned version so Migrator can read old and new pins side by side during migration. Process is single-version: `process/` always holds exactly the currently-active build, with no version suffix, so sessions searching under `process/` never cross version boundaries. The `core_version` field in `workspace.yaml` names the active Upstream pin.

Builds stage under `dist/process/core-<version>/` and promote to `process/` as the last step via an atomic filesystem move. `dist/` is the project-wide convention for script-produced intermediate output; each tool claims its own namespace under it. The staging-then-promote pattern keeps `process/` whole at all times — a build failure leaves `process/` untouched, and a successful build swaps in completely in one move.

Three placeholders flow through the build-time sed sweep: `{project_name}`, `{lore_dir}`, and `{upstream_dir}`. Process paths use the literal `{lore_dir}/process/` (resolved via the `{lore_dir}` sub) — there is no `{process_dir}` placeholder because Process has no version to select.

### Bootstrap rewrite

Two-part procedure:

- **Part 1** — `step1.md` walkthrough: `git clone` Upstream into `.ai-lore-<project_name>/upstream/core/` (unversioned staging path), then run `setup-project.sh` to validate the name, check for ancestor collisions, resolve `core_version` from the clone's changelog, rename `upstream/core/` to `upstream/core-<version>/`, git-init the project root, write `workspace.yaml`, write `.gitignore`, and call `build-process.sh` to stage the build at `dist/process/core-<version>/` and promote it to `process/`.
- **Part 2** — Migrator session loaded via `ai_readme-bootstrap.md`: copy the conformant memory skeleton, seed the blueprint from the chosen plugin, capture project context, verify, **move** (not copy) the rendered `ai_readme.md` from `process/` to the project root.

### Plugin overlay and tree-wide substitution

Build composes the staged tree by copying the versioned core verbatim (excluding `base-stances/` and `plugins/`) and overlaying the chosen plugin from `{upstream_dir}/process/plugins/<plugin>/` on top, excluding the plugin's own `blueprint/` and `changelog/`. Plugin files at non-protected paths win; plugin files at `stances/auditor.md` or `stances/migrator.md` fail the build. A tree-wide sed pass then substitutes three placeholders across every `.md` file in the staged tree: `{project_name}`, `{lore_dir}`, `{upstream_dir}`. Files that discuss the placeholders literally (`project-lifecycle/build/build-process.md`, `project-lifecycle/bootstrap/bootstrap.index.md`, `project-lifecycle/bootstrap/step2.md`, `project-structure.md`, `changelog/`) are excluded from the sweep. The staged tree is then promoted to `process/` via a filesystem move.

### Changelog as source of truth for version

Core ships `process/changelog/` (this folder). `setup-project.sh` resolves `core_version` by reading the highest-numbered `v*.md` file here, writes it into `workspace.yaml`. No git dependency for version capture.

---

### Migration process

`project-lifecycle/migration/migration.index.md` is the authoritative flow for version upgrades. It is Migrator-driven and runs in two parts mirroring bootstrap: **Part 1 — Pull and rebuild** is mechanical (pull new Upstream next to the old via `migrate-pull.sh`, present the changelog, pause for confirmation, load the version-specific playbook, pause again, flip the pin in `workspace.yaml`, rebuild `process/` through the `dist/` staging pattern); **Part 2 — Memory reshape** walks the Memory through the structural changes the new pillars require, propose-and-confirm per edit. Two confirmation pauses (post-changelog, post-playbook) keep abort harmless up to the pin flip; rollback after the flip is "flip the pin back and rebuild."

Versioned Upstream is what makes rollback cheap: old and new pins coexist under `upstream/core-<version>/`, so backing out is a rebuild from existing source, not a re-clone. Single-version Process keeps runtime simple: a fresh session on either version sees exactly one `process/` tree.

## Migration from v0.3

Migration from v0.3 → v0.4 is structural (Lore folder rename, memory model expansion with blueprint promoted out of the KT, tracker primitive, new index-per-folder discipline, `upstream/` + `process/` trees created for the first time, `workspace.yaml` schema rewrite, stance consolidation). The shape diff is large enough that the upgrade is framed as *re-bootstrap with memory import*, not a mechanical pin flip.

The version-specific playbook is shipped at [`migration-from-v0.3.md`](./migration-from-v0.3.md), a peer file in this release folder. From v0.4 onwards each release lives as its own folder under `changelog/` — the release notes (`v<version>.index.md`) and any migration playbooks (`migration-from-<predecessor>.md`) sit together. Migrator loads the playbook at Step 4 of the generic migration flow (`project-lifecycle/migration/migration.index.md`) by reading `{lore_dir}/upstream/core-<new>/process/changelog/<new>/migration-from-<old>.md`. For this upgrade the playbook replaces the generic flow's Steps 1–5 with a bespoke Part 1 (establish the v0.4 shell: rename Lore, clone v0.4 upstream, stage old memory to `memory.v03/`, rewrite workspace.yaml, run the build, run bootstrap Part 2 Steps 4–5) and defines Part 2 as a guided, file-by-file import walk from `memory.v03/` into the fresh v0.4 skeleton.

Key reshapes the playbook handles:

- **Lore folder rename** — `.ai-lore/` → `.ai-lore-<project_name>/`, picked once up front.
- **Blueprint promotion** — moves from `knowledge-tree/blueprint/` to its own top-level `memory/blueprint/`.
- **Typed index files** — every folder acquires a `[folder-name].index.md` under v0.4's tree-discipline; v0.3 was looser about this.
- **Typed focus files** — `status/focus/<name>.md` → `status/focus/<name>.focus.md` with the full four-field tracker shape from `focus.template.md`.
- **Journal verbatim copy** — journal files are append-forward unconditionally, never reshaped during migration.
- **`workspace.yaml` schema rewrite** — drops `plugin_version`, `plugin_readme`, `code`, `memory`, `methodology`; requires `project_name`.

Rollback is cheap up to the build step in Part 1 (Step 1.5) and recoverable through the rest of Part 2 via Migrator's propose-then-confirm discipline. See the playbook's Rollback section for the specific recovery steps at each stage.

## Known issues — deferred to v0.4.1

Surfaced by the link-integrity sweep at the promotion pass (2026-04-15). All 18 defects sit inside plugin sub-trees; the six core pillars and their load path are clean. None affect session open or the focus chain; each is a broken cross-reference inside a plugin file a session reads by name, not by link.

- **`plugins/spec/stances/architect.md`** — 4 links to `../stances.md` should be `../../../stances.md` (three levels up to core `process/stances.md`).
- **`plugins/sdlc/action-tree.md`** — 2 links to `../../action-tree.md` should be `../../memory/action-tree.md` (v0.4 moved action-tree under the memory pillar).
- **`plugins/sdlc/conventions.md`** — 2 links to `../../conventions.md` (file does not exist in v0.4; content folded into `memory/tree-discipline.md`) and 1 link to `./roles.md` (v0.3 filename; v0.4 uses `stances/`). File is v0.3-flavoured content inside a v0.4 plugin path and needs a rewrite, not a path fix.
- **`plugins/{sdlc,spec,ttrpg}/blueprint/blueprint.index.md`** — each links to `../memory.index.md`; correct target is `../../../memory/memory.index.md` (3 links).
- **`plugins/{sdlc,spec,ttrpg}/changelog/index.md`** — each links to `../../../changelog/index.md` (v0.3 filename; v0.4 renamed the root index to `changelog.index.md`) and `../ai_readme.md` (file v0.4 does not ship). 6 links across 3 files; the whole plugin changelog stub shape is v0.3 cruft and should be reauthored for v0.4.

Fix shape: path corrections are mechanical for items 1, 2, and 4. Items 3 and 5 are content rewrites, not path fixes. All land together as v0.4.1 alongside Strategist Findings 3 and 6.
